title: penstemon nitidus subsp. typicus
intro: Penstemon nitidus subsp. typicus, commonly known as Smooth Penstemon or Narrow-leaved Beardtongue, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include promoting digestive health, reducing inflammation, and soothing respiratory issues. The plant is believed to have therapeutic actions such as demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. Bioactive constituents found in Penstemon nitidus subsp. typicus include glycosides, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
